experiment_data.hypothesis: GRPO recovery on ShortGPT depth-pruned model (5/28 layers removed by BI scoring, 15.3% sparsity). After SFT warmup (loss=0.62). Tests whether coarse layer removal (ShortGPT) leads to lower GRPO recovery than fine-grained structural pruning (CKA-only 64.37%, Standard 59.44%, RASP 60.88%). Expected to show collapse or severe stagnation because removing entire layers destroys more distributed representations needed for RL training.
